title: Earthy Gooey Malaysian Coconut Oil Curry
description: A rich and energizing curry featuring saffron and coconut oil, served with a side of steamed jasmine rice. This dish is satvik-friendly and perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: saffron threads
ingredients.notes: soaked in 1 tablespoon hot water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for another minute.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the soaked saffron threads and their liquid, and stir well.
Add the turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Add the coconut milk and stir well to combine.
Bring the curry to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice.
